vibe_rationale: Community skate day that takes over central Lima with a mass route, music, art and contests; grassroots and joyful, though single-day.
fit_notes: Mixed-age Lima skate community with an active-lifestyle angle; the age split and attendance are not published. Five skate-brand partners are listed, but no partnership page or contact was found. A hydration or recovery station on the route would be low cost and authentic, with a Peruvian partner needed on the ground.
